name: ID-JAG Standalone LAB
description: API collection for ID-JAG Standalone LAB: inspect tokens, run the playground's negative tests, and drive the live flow (issue ID-JAG by RFC 8693 exchange, redeem by RFC 7523, call the MCP server). Sign-in-gated steps need a browser sign-in session first (the pi.flow precondition folder); in Live mode the server keeps the tokens and returns decoded claims only.

env.PF_EXCHANGE_CLIENT_ID: OAuth client allowed to perform the RFC 8693 token exchange
env.ID_JAG_RESOURCE: Resource/audience the ID-JAG is issued for
env.RESOURCE_AS_ISSUER: Issuer of the resource authorization server that redeems the ID-JAG
env.RESOURCE_AS_CLIENT_SECRET: Secret of the client that redeems the ID-JAG (RFC 7523 JWT bearer)
env.MCP_URL: Token endpoint or MCP server URL the redeemed access token is used against

folders.name: Inspect (no sign-in needed)
folders.description: Decode and check a pasted token. Works without a session; never sends the token anywhere except the lab's own checker.

requests.name: BYO inspect a pasted ID-JAG (invalid sample, negative)

folders.name: pi.flow sign-in (browser-assisted precondition)
folders.description: Live-mode issue/redeem/call act on the browser sign-in session's tokens. Start the sign-in in a browser at /api/id-jag-playground, complete pi.flow, then run the flow folders. These requests show the shape; they cannot replace the browser step.

requests.name: Credentials POST shape (will 409 pi_flow_not_started without a browser start)

folders.name: Flow (signed-in session required)
folders.description: The live ID-JAG flow against the servers named in the environment: issue (RFC 8693 token exchange), redeem (RFC 7523 JWT bearer), and call the MCP server with the redeemed access token. Each answers 409 with the missing prerequisite when a step was skipped.

folders.name: Negative tests catalog
folders.description: The playground's negative tests, each with its expected OAuth error. GET lists them; POST runs one (needs a signed-in session and an issued ID-JAG; skipped answers pass:null with a note).

requests.name: Run the replay test (skipped without a redeemed ID-JAG)
